paragraphs: I'm applying for the Advanced Specialist, Corporate Development role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is the mandate: minority investments in edtech and workforce companies, close to the business Pearson already knows well.

In my MBA I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, built a DCF with WACC and sensitivity analysis matched against a sell-side model, and built an LBO model for the same company. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan I modeled $10M in marketing-channel budget, quantifying ROI across scenarios.

That maps to the market analysis, valuation and returns work the team does. My valuation work comes from coursework rather than live deals, so I'd bring careful modeling and clear write-ups and learn the investing side from your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Advanced Specialist, Corporate Development role at Pearson. In my MBA I built a DCF, comps and an LBO for J.M. Smucker, and at Lenovo I built scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'd like to hear how the team picks edtech investments. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
